operations.description:
Lists shelves. The order is unspecified but deterministic. Newly created
shelves will not necessarily be added to the end of this list.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] libraryagent shelves list [PATH] shelves [PARAMS] access alt callback fields key oauth page pretty print protocol quota size token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] example google libraryagent list response shelf shelves

operations.description: Gets a book. Returns NOT_FOUND if the book does not exist.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] libraryagent shelves books [PATH]  [PARAMS] access alt callback fields key name oauth pretty print protocol quota token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] book example google libraryagent

operations.description:
Lists books in a shelf. The order is unspecified but deterministic. Newly
created books will not necessarily be added to the end of this list.
Returns NOT_FOUND if the shelf does not exist.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] libraryagent shelves books list [PATH] books [PARAMS] access alt callback fields key oauth page parent pretty print protocol quota size token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] book books example google libraryagent list response

operations.description:
Borrow a book from the library. Returns the book if it is borrowed
successfully. Returns NOT_FOUND if the book does not exist in the library.
Returns quota exceeded error if the amount of books borrowed exceeds
allocation quota in any dimensions.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] libraryagent shelves books borrow [PATH] name borrow [PARAMS] access alt callback fields key name oauth pretty print protocol quota token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] book example google libraryagent

operations.description:
Return a book to the library. Returns the book if it is returned to the
library successfully.
Returns error if the book does not belong to the library
or the users didn't borrow before.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] libraryagent shelves books return [PATH] name return [PARAMS] access alt callback fields key name oauth pretty print protocol quota token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] book example google libraryagent
